[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-6l[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Daily Stats — derived daily metrics, a review journal, bob stats, [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]and an Obsidian Stats page[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Bryan can open Stats (Obsidian) or run `bob stats` (terminal) [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]during the weekly prune, understand how the last weeks went in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]about a minute, trust where every number came from, and add a new [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]daily metric with a few lines of config — with no daily logging [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]habit and no data written that the vault already keeps.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Start the clock — the review journal writer[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]journal[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]journal: bob-ledger-tools gains api.stats v1 (serialized append queue) [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and bob-navigation-hotkeys journals every counted ]s answer to per-host [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]monthly JSONL under .bob/stats/review/; the vault allowlists the files; [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob-cli gains docs/stats.md with the journal contract and shared [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vectors.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The stats engine in bob-cli[/bold #D7AFFF]                                   [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]engine[dim] · [dim][/dim]after journal[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]engine: single-pass stats index, metric registry with built-ins written [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]as config entries, the stats: config section, six metric kinds, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ranges/grouping/summaries/display strings, and a golden fixture vault, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exposed as one compute() returning the schema-1 JSON model.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The bob stats command[/bold #D7AFFF]                                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after engine[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli: register bob stats (overview default, show, metrics) in Daily [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workflow with human, json, and csv output, the colored terminal glance [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and detail charts, help/completion/README wiring, and real-vault parity [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Obsidian Stats page — data path, tiles, and table[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]page[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]page: bob-ledger-tools api.stats v2 spawns bob stats with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stale-while-revalidate caching, the bob-stats block renders the header, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]range controls, tile row, table view, and every honest state; the vault [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gains dash_stats.md, the dash entry point, the weekly-prune link, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Open Stats.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Obsidian Stats page — focus chart, context panels, and [/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]interaction[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]charts[dim] · [dim][/dim]after page[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]charts: hand-rolled SVG focus chart with rolling median, normal band, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]today/missing marks and prior ticks; per-family context panels (themes, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]flow, review, calendar and chore grids); day drill-down, tooltips, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]keyboard, definition popover, and a rendered light/dark preview check.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Rollout — real-vault verification, docs, and memory[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]rollout[dim] · [dim][/dim]after charts[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]rollout: verify end to end on the live vault and every installed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]surface, record measured performance, finish docs and README [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cross-links, apply only the accepted memory decisions, and record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]follow-ups.[/#D7D7AF]
